decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo printer shares core technology, consumables and service with the established range, so holding it costs little, and the missing website evidence after 2019 does not show it has failed.
The numbering software module is cheap to maintain and fits the firm's push toward serialization and traceability, so this low-cost option is worth keeping open.
The coder for non-absorbent surfaces draws on the firm's ink expertise and serves a broad, recurring marking need with consumables revenue, so its option value remains.
The CodeScan app already succeeded an earlier app and costs very little to maintain, while it supports the firm's traceability and digitalization direction, so keeping it is a cheap option.
Inline code verification is central to serialization and compliance demand, which is growing, so the firm should commit further rather than abandon it.
The layout design software is a common operating layer across the firm's printers that supports one-stop solutions at low marginal cost, so it should stay.
